about: Which checks test each event in the report's timeline (process_model.json events_2008_08_28). scripts/bayer_walkthrough.py pairs each event with the replayed screen at that moment and with these checks: the figure-against-text checks in out/bayer_rt/fig11_check.json (by name) and the report-statement checks in out/bayer_rt/replay_states.json (K1-K5). Every check must sit under exactly one event; a test fails otherwise.
